title: A degreewise split short exact sequence of complexes gives the cone triangle
statement: Let A be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and let 0 \to I_A^\bullet \to I_B^\bullet \to I_C^\bullet \to 0 be a degreewise split short exact sequence of cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Choose degreewise retractions pi from I_B to I_A and sections s from I_C to I_B, with pi after the inclusion equal to the identity, the projection after s equal to the identity, and inclusion after pi plus s after projection equal to the identity [lem-weil-pbc-degreewise-split-connecting-morphism]. Define delta from I_C to the shifted complex I_A[1] by delta in degree n equal to pi in degree n+1 after the differential of I_B in degree n after s in degree n. In the derived category, the triangle I_A \to I_B \to I_C \to I_A[1] with third map delta is distinguished; under the cone convention its third map corresponds to the cone triangle with third morphism minus the projection, so the sign of delta is fixed by these splittings.
